about: Prism Deck Game Link demo: a fictional Dota 2 match (a Radiant Juggernaut) as the Game State Integration posts a live player receives, in order, with their receive times (atMs). Player-mode shapes from public research (aaa-prism-play/dota2/research-gsi.md), every value invented: Steam ids are out-of-range fictional ids, the account id, name and match id are made up, the auth token is an example. Only key posts are kept (the game sends about one a second).

frames.note: The dashboard (menu): only provider + a 4-field player. No map.
Hero selection: the map (rules state HERO_SELECTION), the player on Radiant with starting gold; no hero yet.
Strategy time: the hero is picked (only id + name, as the game sends early on).
Pre-game (clock −1:30, night before the horn): the hero, abilities and starting items appear.
The horn: GAME_IN_PROGRESS, clock 0:00, the first dawn.
Laning (3:10): level 3, Blade Fury on cooldown (the first post after the cast reads 24 — the sweep's length).
Eleven seconds later: the cooldown reads 13 (the HUD's own number).
Night falls at 5:00 (5-minute halves): daytime false.
Level 6: Omnislash learned — ready at once.
First blood (6:42), ours: kills 1, the Radiant score 1 – 0, Omnislash spent (cooldown 130).
Silenced by an enemy (7:10): the ability keys lock, items stay usable.
The silence ends.
Hexed (8:30): abilities and items lock.
The hex ends.
Omnislash comes off cooldown (8:52).
Day at 10:00.
A Smoke of Deceit (11:05): smoked true, the smoke leaves the inventory (level 9).
The smoke gank: a kill breaks the smoke (kills 2, streak 2; 2 – 0).
Stunned and burst (13:58): 22 % health.
Death (14:00): alive false, respawn 34 s, buyback 1,060 gold off cooldown with 1,540 gold — buyback ready.
The respawn countdown ticks (33).
Buyback (14:10): alive, gold −1,060, buyback cooldown 480.
Roshan falls to the Radiant (18:20): the events block's roshan_killed (announced to all ten players); level 13.
We pick up the Aegis (aegis_picked_up; the item in our inventory).
Our tier-1 bottom tower falls (player mode reports only our own buildings: it drops out).
The teamfight (22:00), level 15: Omnislash cast — cooldown 110 (its sweep's length).
Kill 3 (22:01); streak 1.
Kill 4 (22:04): Double — within 18 s of the last; streak 2.
Kill 5 (22:08): Triple — within 18 s of the last; streak 3.
Kill 6 (22:13): Ultra — within 18 s of the last; streak 4.
Kill 7 (22:19): RAMPAGE — within 18 s of the last; streak 5.
After the fight: Omnislash 80, Manta 19 of its 30.
Level 16.
Omnislash ready again (23:50).
The Dire ancient falls (31:40): win_team radiant, POST_GAME — victory, 31 – 14 (our K/D/A as of the last kill post).
Back to the dashboard.
